decisions.reason: The foldable large container's earlier dedicated page and strategic fit suggest results still exceed aspirations, and organizational slack supports retaining it while monitoring uncertain visibility.

Although pallets are core, this medium-duty rackable model has shown weak traction and no recent website presence, falling short of aspirations and making withdrawal preferable.
The spill-retention pallet's environmental compliance niche and earlier own page suggest it still meets aspirations, so slack supports keeping it.
